harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired node1’s bin/unpack. It now preflights the complete archive, accepts ordinary nested files, rejects absolute paths, parent traversal, links, and unsupported member types before installation, and uses no-follow directory-relative writes. Source packages, protected data, Ubuntu 24.04.3, and kernel 6.8.0-71 were preserved. Persistence was verified after reboot.
actions_performed: Replaced the unsafe direct tar extraction with a Python 3 standard-library implementation.
Validated every archive member before creating or modifying incoming/.
Restricted extraction to regular files and directories; rejected symbolic and hard links.
Installed files using directory descriptors, O_NOFOLLOW, temporary files, and atomic replacement.
Tested the normal and all malformed supplied packages.
Safely rebooted node1 and repeated functional and integrity checks.

evidence.requirement: Ordinary nested files are accepted into incoming/
evidence.summary: normal.tar successfully installed incoming/docs/notice.txt before and after reboot with hash 558d9460…d6e8b3.

evidence.requirement: Absolute paths, parent traversal, and symlink escapes are rejected before any members are installed
evidence.summary: All malformed archives exited 2. /outside.txt, incoming/outside.txt, incoming/accepted.txt, and incoming/escape remained absent; the existing valid file was unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Source packages and protected files are preserved
evidence.summary: All four package hashes and protected/customer.txt hash remained identical through testing and reboot.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel are preserved
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS and kernel 6.8.0-71-generic were unchanged.
Healthy baseline boot ID 242af11e… was captured, safe reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 11136ae4… proved restart, and system state, unpack behavior, data, and integrity checks fully recovered.
